content: On reception of a UDS Service 0x10 request (Diagnostic Session Control) with subfunction 0x02 (Start Programming Session), the Dcm shall set the ReprogramingRequest flag and, if indicated for this service, the ResponseRequired flag by calling Dcm_SetProgConditions .
